description: This file defines the EnterpriseCallbackControls class with static methods to manage and check if callbacks are disabled dynamically, based on headers or request parameters, within an enterprise context.

classes.name: EnterpriseCallbackControls
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to determine if callbacks are disabled dynamically based on headers or request parameters.

methods.name: is_callback_disabled_dynamically
methods.description: Checks if a specific callback is disabled via headers or dynamic parameters, considering enterprise rules and user privileges.

methods.name: get_disabled_callbacks
methods.description: Retrieves a list of disabled callbacks from request headers or request body parameters.

methods.name: _should_allow_dynamic_callback_disabling
methods.description: Determines if dynamic callback disabling is permitted based on admin settings and user privileges.
